title: Sun-Kissed Chicken Stir Fry
description: A delicious and easy stir-fry recipe made with sun-kissed Australian chicken, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet.
Add the onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the snow peas to the skillet and cook until tender, about 2-3 minutes.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir in the stir-fry sauce and soy sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the chicken and vegetables hot over rice or noodles.
